title: NCAA: Raymundo shines as Generals survive Red Lions rally, force do-or-die
summary: With its back against the wall against the defending champions, Emilio Aguinaldo College displayed poise under pressure to stay alive in the NCAA Season 102 men's basketball Final Four.
